global_continuity.style_summary: Documentary-realistic founder workspace, warm neutral daylight, close practical details, and restrained movement.
continuity_requirements: Keep one calm founder workspace across scenes.
Use anonymized cards, notes, and roadmap shapes with no readable details.
Preserve soft daylight and warm neutral palette throughout.
global_continuity.character_continuity: Use hands-only or a generic non-identifiable founder presence; do not imply a real founder likeness.
global_continuity.environment_continuity: Desk, notes, and planning board should feel like the same small workspace.

text_policy.generated_asset_policy: Generated image/video assets must be text-free and unobstructed.
text_policy.renderer_text_policy: Any opening title, captions, subtitles, or labels are reserved for later renderer metadata, not generated pixels.

prompts.subject: Generic founder workspace with laptop, abstract notes, and calm work artifacts.
prompts.environment: Small desk or office corner in soft daylight with warm neutral colors.
prompts.composition: Vertical 9:16 frame, clean central desk focal point, shallow background detail, mobile-readable subject silhouette.
prompts.camera: Still documentary frame with a slightly close work surface angle.
prompts.motion: Still image hold with optional subtle digital push added later by the renderer.
prompts.lighting: Soft morning daylight, low contrast, warm practical highlights.
prompts.style: Founder explainer, documentary-realistic, restrained SaaS workspace aesthetic.
continuity_requirements: Use the same workspace palette as later scenes.
Keep all note and ticket-like objects unreadable.
Do not create a real identifiable founder face.
prompts.text_policy: No generated readable text; opening title belongs only to later renderer metadata.
prompts.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 documentary-realistic still image of a generic founder desk in soft morning daylight, laptop closed beside clustered abstract sticky notes and blurred support-card shapes, one clear central work surface focal point, warm neutral palette, shallow background, calm practical founder-explainer mood, clean unobstructed composition, no readable text, no UI copy, no logos, no labels, no subtitles, no watermark.
prompts.negative_prompt: readable text, letters, numbers, UI, support ticket words, sticky note writing, labels, logo, watermark, subtitles, captions, title text, signage, real person likeness, distorted hands, cluttered collage, generic dark atmosphere
prompts.fallback_prompt: Text-free vertical documentary still of a calm founder desk with abstract unreadable notes and soft daylight, warm neutral palette, clean central focal point.
safety_notes: Keep the founder generic and non-identifiable.
Do not imply real customer data.
qa_checks: Frame can support renderer-added title later without obstruction.
Subject, environment, and style are specific enough for generation.

prompts.subject: Anonymized support cards and founder hands in the same workspace.
prompts.environment: Founder desk with slightly busier card arrangement and blurred work artifacts.
prompts.composition: Medium-close vertical framing moving from scattered cards to early clusters.
prompts.camera: Gentle lateral documentary camera move following the cards.
prompts.motion: Cards and hands shift from messy scattered support volume into the first visible grouping pattern.
prompts.lighting: Soft daylight with slightly busier contrast than the opening scene.
prompts.style: Documentary founder explainer with practical, grounded workspace realism.
continuity_requirements: Match scene 1 desk, color palette, and light quality.
Keep all cards abstract and unreadable.
Use hands or workspace details instead of identifiable faces.
prompts.text_policy: No readable support ticket text, UI, labels, captions, or signage.
prompts.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 documentary-realistic video shot at the same founder desk, generic hands sorting scattered abstract support cards into early clusters, cards are blurred and unreadable, laptop and workspace artifacts stay background-soft, medium-close composition, gentle lateral camera move, warm neutral daylight, practical founder-operator mood showing support overload beginning to reveal patterns, no readable text, no UI copy, no customer names, no logos, no subtitles, no watermark.
prompts.negative_prompt: readable tickets, customer names, UI text, email inbox text, dashboard labels, logos, watermark, subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, fake metrics, chaotic collage, dramatic panic imagery, identifiable customer faces
prompts.fallback_prompt: Text-free vertical video of generic hands sorting abstract unreadable support cards on a warm founder desk, moving from scattered cards to simple grouped patterns.
safety_notes: Do not imply a real support queue.
qa_checks: No provider-specific or render-specific instructions appear.

prompts.subject: Founder hands grouping separate abstract notes into one shared pain-point cluster.
prompts.environment: Same desk or adjacent planning board with consistent warm daylight.
prompts.composition: Tight vertical composition centered on three separate note groups becoming one cluster.
prompts.camera: Subtle push-in as the repeated pattern becomes clear.
prompts.motion: Hands move three color-coded note groups into one central cluster.
prompts.lighting: Warm daylight with clear focus on notes and hands.
prompts.style: Practical founder explainer, documentary close-up, tactile workflow detail.
continuity_requirements: Keep color palette aligned with prior scenes.
Represent three inputs without numbers or readable labels.
prompts.text_policy: No legible labels, card text, numbers, diagrams, or UI elements.
prompts.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 documentary-realistic close-up video of generic founder hands moving three separate groups of color-coded abstract notes into one central cluster on a warm desk or planning board, notes are blank or blurred with no readable marks, subtle push-in camera motion as the pattern becomes obvious, soft daylight, grounded product-operator mood, clear subject-action-setting, no readable text, no numbers, no labels, no UI, no logos, no subtitles, no watermark.
prompts.negative_prompt: readable labels, written notes, numbers, charts, fake metrics, product UI, logos, subtitles, captions, watermark, generic symbolic imagery, random portrait, exaggerated success proof
prompts.fallback_prompt: Text-free vertical video close-up of generic hands grouping three abstract note clusters into one central pattern on a warm founder workspace.
safety_notes: Keep the pattern visual without text.
qa_checks: No fake metrics or labels appear.
Prompt includes subject, action, environment, camera, lighting, and style.

prompts.subject: Abstract roadmap board and founder hands arranging clean priority shapes.
prompts.environment: Same founder workspace, calmer and less cluttered than earlier scenes.
prompts.composition: Vertical final frame with clean board or desk arrangement and uncluttered negative space.
prompts.camera: Slow settling move into a final hold.
prompts.motion: Hands place final abstract priority shapes into a simple roadmap-like sequence.
prompts.lighting: Soft calm daylight with gentle resolution and warm neutral tones.
prompts.style: Founder explainer with documentary realism and restrained optimistic finish.
continuity_requirements: Use the same workspace and palette as earlier scenes.
Carry the abstract cards into a cleaner roadmap arrangement.
prompts.text_policy: No readable roadmap items, labels, UI text, captions, or logos.
prompts.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 documentary-realistic video of generic founder hands arranging blank abstract priority shapes into a clean roadmap-like sequence on the same warm desk or planning board, workspace is calmer and less cluttered, slow settling camera move into final hold, soft daylight, practical resolved founder-explainer mood, clear visual link from support patterns to priorities, no readable text, no roadmap words, no UI, no labels, no logos, no subtitles, no watermark.
prompts.negative_prompt: readable roadmap text, labels, UI, product screenshots, logos, subtitles, captions, watermark, guaranteed outcome imagery, fake company branding, salesy hero shot, generic background
prompts.fallback_prompt: Text-free vertical video of generic hands arranging blank abstract priority shapes into a simple roadmap pattern on a warm founder desk.
safety_notes: Do not imply real company roadmap details.
Do not add guaranteed outcome visuals.
qa_checks: Visual ending feels practical rather than promotional.
Continuity with earlier workspace is preserved.

qa_focus: Every prompt names concrete subject, action, environment, composition, camera, motion, lighting, and style.
Generated assets are text-free by default.
Fallback prompts are simpler but still specific.
No provider, model, host, storage, render, or publish choice appears.
